questions.q: Which law of Bob Burg's focuses on helping customers enjoy a memorable experience?
questions.why: The first law is the Law of Value, about customer experience.

questions.q: What example illustrates that perfect products alone don't guarantee repeat business?
questions.why: The text uses a hotdog stand to show product limits.

questions.q: Which law encourages being genuine rather than scripted?
questions.why: Authenticity is the law about being genuine.

questions.q: Who is described as a go‑getter whose hard work made goals feel distant?
questions.why: Joe is the example of a hard‑working but distant-goal person.

questions.q: What is the first of Burg's five laws of stratospheric success?
questions.why: The first law listed is Value.
